scoring_justification: Recompute Reuss-model fit and ratio from raw elastic_data.csv; validate CSV shape/plausibility and self-consistency of reported fit params.

hidden_assets.purpose: target ratio E_GB/E_core = 40/146 ≈ 0.274 from the paper's Reuss CNA ∞‑norm fit
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1 and discussion; E_core=146 GPa, E_GB=40 GPa is the preferred ∞‑norm CNA fit.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Hardcoded from the paper's own reported values for the exact quantity the task reproduces.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Directly taken from the source paper's main quantitative result under the same conditions the agent is instructed to reproduce.

schema.description: Three rows, one per grain size (≈5, 10, 15 nm).

outputs.description: Raw data from MD tensile tests: overall Young's modulus and core volume fraction. The checker recomputes the Reuss fit and ratio from this file.
Fitted Young's moduli from the Reuss model. Checker verifies self-consistency with elastic_data.csv.
Ratio E_GB/E_core. Checker verifies self-consistency with fit parameters and elastic data.

output_contract.notes: The primary scoring metric is the recomputed ratio from elastic_data.csv; reuss_fit_params.txt and ratio.txt serve as consistency checks.
